boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Indianola destinations on nearby Buxton, Salem, B Street, and 1st Street corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Buxton Park — gardens and public art
cards.subtitle: N Buxton Street corridor, beside Simpson College
cards.notes: Enter from N Buxton Street and use the self-guided arboretum tour pamphlet near the gazebo; pause for the fountain, gardens, and sculptures.
cards.short_summary: A city park with an arboretum, formal and butterfly gardens, fountain, gazebo, and public art.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Buxton Park is adjacent to Simpson College and includes an arboretum, gardens, fountain, gazebo, and sculptures.
cards.access_notes: City lists the address as 705 N. Buxton Street; no restroom facilities are available.

cards.title: Indianola Public Library — books and more
cards.subtitle: N B Street corridor, on the Downtown Square
cards.notes: Use the library as a daytime stop for books, public resources, or current programming; ask staff about its listed Adventure Pass options.
cards.short_summary: The public library offers books, community programs, and Adventure Pass information.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official page lists books and resources, a summer reading program, and Adventure Passes for cardholders.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current schedule and any card requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Pageturners Bookstore — new and used books
cards.subtitle: E Salem Avenue corridor, 101 E Salem Ave.
cards.notes: Browse the new and used shelves, then ask staff to help locate a title or place an order for a book not currently in stock.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore carrying books plus cards, puzzles, gifts, and journals.
cards.evidence_claim: Pageturners identifies itself as a locally owned independent bookstore with new and used adult and children’s books.
cards.access_notes: The business lists its location as 101 E Salem Ave.; confirm current hours before heading over.

cards.title: CanoeSport Outfitters — paddling gear and classes
cards.subtitle: W Salem Avenue corridor, 203 W Salem Ave.
cards.notes: Visit the retail store to explore canoe, kayak, and SUP offerings, then use the official site to review current instruction or tour options.
cards.short_summary: A paddlesports retailer offering sales, rentals, trips, and instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: CanoeSport Outfitters lists canoe, kayak, and SUP sales, instruction, rentals, and trips at its Indianola retail store.
cards.access_notes: Its official site lists the retail store at 203 W Salem Ave. and publishes current store hours.

cards.title: The Stitching Place — quilt and embroidery supplies
cards.subtitle: N Buxton Street corridor, 127 N Buxton St.
cards.notes: Stop in to see quilt, machine-embroidery, and sewing supplies; check the shop’s current schedule before planning a project-supply run.
cards.short_summary: A full-service quilt shop specializing in machine embroidery and sewing supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stitching Place describes itself as a full-service quilt shop specializing in machine embroidery and lists 127 N Buxton St.
cards.access_notes: The shop publishes weekday and Saturday hours; verify them before visiting.

cards.title: Indianola Glass Creations — stained and fused glass
cards.subtitle: N Buxton Street corridor, 119 N Buxton St.
cards.notes: Look through stained and fused glass work and supplies, or use the business’s class information when planning a hands-on creative activity.
cards.short_summary: A glass-art shop offering stained and fused glass supplies, artwork, and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Indianola Glass Creations says it carries stained and fused glass supplies and offers classes, including paint-your-own pottery.
cards.access_notes: The City’s downtown directory lists Indianola Glass Creations at 119 N Buxton St.; confirm class availability directly.

cards.title: Feed & Foster — housewares and pantry goods
cards.subtitle: N Buxton Street corridor, 103 N Buxton St.
cards.notes: Browse the shop’s documented housewares and goods when looking for a practical item or gift; check directly for current merchandise and hours.
cards.short_summary: A Downtown Square retailer focused on simple, functional housewares and goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Travel Iowa describes Feed & Foster as specializing in simple and functional housewares and goods at 103 N Buxton.
cards.access_notes: Travel Iowa lists the address as 103 N Buxton, Indianola; confirm current operating details with the business.

cards.title: The Little Shed on Salem — rustic home finds
cards.subtitle: Salem Avenue corridor, on the Downtown Square
cards.notes: Add this Salem Avenue storefront to a Square walk when browsing home-oriented goods; check its current inventory and opening information before going.
cards.short_summary: A named Downtown Square shop highlighted for rustic, home-oriented finds.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Indianola identifies The Little Shed on Salem as a Downtown Square shop and describes it as offering rustic, cozy finds.
cards.access_notes: The City’s Downtown Square map lists The Little Shed on Salem; confirm the storefront’s current hours directly.

cards.title: Back Alley Bikes — bike-service stop
cards.subtitle: Salem Avenue corridor, on the Downtown Square
cards.notes: Use the shop’s official site to check current bike-service or retail details before making a Square stop, especially if you need a specific repair.
cards.short_summary: A named Downtown Square bicycle business with an official Indianola-facing website.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s current Downtown Square map lists Back Alley Bikes, and the business maintains an official website.
cards.source_title: Indianola Downtown Square Map | City of Indianola
cards.access_notes: The City’s map was last updated May 2026; consult the business directly for current service availability.

cards.title: Paramount 7 — a movie showing
cards.subtitle: S 1st Street corridor, 105 S 1st St.
cards.notes: Check the theater’s official location page for the current schedule, then plan a film outing on the south side of the Downtown Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Fridley Theatres lists its Indianola location as Paramount 7 at 105 S 1st Street.
cards.access_notes: Use the theater’s official site to verify showtimes, admission, and any age-related film restrictions.
